description: This file defines a development-only utility function 'devTryProjectCost' used to simulate project cost history data during local development. It throws an error if invoked in production, and otherwise returns mock data after a brief delay.

methods.name: devTryProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: An async function that simulates fetching project cost history for a given project ID during local development, throwing an error in production environments.
